title: Implement reassemble() — ordered concatenation and UU decode
description:
Implement the final reassembly step in src/reassemble.rs.

This is the top-level output function of the crate. It takes a complete (or partial) PartCollection, concatenates the body bytes of data parts in order, and feeds the result to uuencoding::decode().

Public types:

  pub struct ReassembledFile {
      pub filename: String,         // from UU begin line
      pub mode: u32,                // from UU begin line (octal permissions)
      pub data: Vec<u8>,            // decoded file bytes
      pub is_truncated: bool,       // true if any parts were missing or UU was truncated
      pub missing_parts: Vec<u32>,  // gaps that were skipped
  }

Public function:
  pub fn reassemble(collection: &PartCollection) -> Result<ReassembledFile, MultiUuError>

Algorithm:
1. Collect data parts: all entries with part_number >= 1, sorted ascending.
2. If no data parts: return Err(MultiUuError::EmptyCollection).
3. Detect missing parts: if collection.missing_parts() is non-empty, record them in result.missing_parts and set is_truncated=true. DO NOT return Err — reassemble best-effort with what is available (skip gaps; the UU decoder will likely hit UnexpectedEof which is handled).
4. Concatenate body_bytes of present data parts in ascending part_number order into one Vec<u8>.
5. Call uuencoding::decode(&concatenated) -> Result<DecodedBlock, UuError>.
6. If decode returns Err: map to MultiUuError::DecodeError(e) and return Err.
7. If decode returns Ok(block): build ReassembledFile from block.metadata (filename, mode) and block.data. Set is_truncated = block.is_truncated || !missing_parts.is_empty().
8. Return Ok(reassembled).

Security note (must appear in doc comment on reassemble()):
  The decoded data is raw bytes that may be a compressed archive. The caller is
  responsible for any decompression size limits. This crate does not decompress.

Tests (oracle: UNIX uuencode + uudecode or Python uu module — NOT this crate):
  - Complete 3-part file: reassemble -> correct bytes
  - 2-of-3 parts present: reassemble -> is_truncated=true, missing_parts=[2], partial data
  - Single-part collection (part 1 only)
  - Correct filename and mode extracted from begin line
  - Empty collection -> Err(EmptyCollection)
  - UU decode error propagated -> Err(DecodeError(...))
